queue_correction: Keep later-stage source acquisition concurrent with Stage1 improvements; finalStage1 HD quality is not a prerequisite for stock capture.
Require a concrete owner, next output, source blocker and admission gate for each later-stage lane.
Use shared GPU windows and sequential heavy CPU work. Claimed tasks/ledger names alone do not prove active model workers.
important_limits: Manifest hashes were checked now; no PNG decode, per-image hashing or fresh pixel acceptance test was run.
Older zero-mismatch reports often validate native cell centres. No fresh strict whole-cell pass is claimed for later stages.
Candidate counts are selected metadata, not complete per-stage requirement denominators or completion percentages.
Stage4/6 effects and Stage3 material folders are alternatives/replacements, not additive unique-key counts.
